```{python}
ha=ha.dropna()
```
```{python}
ha.info()
```

```{python}
ha["sex"]=ha["sex"].astype("str")
ha["cp"]=ha["cp"].astype("str")
ha["restecg"]=ha["restecg"].astype("str")
```

## Logistic Regression 

```{python}
y=ha["diagnosis"]
X=ha[["age", "chol"]]

logistic_regression=LogisticRegression().fit(X,y)
print(logistic_regression.coef_, logistic_regression.intercept_)
```

0.04686331 age + 0.00180124 chol - 3.24011226 = 0 

```{python}
(0.04686331*55 - 3.24011226)/(-0.00180124)
```

A 55 year old would have to have a cholestorol of 367.87 for the doctors to predict heart disease is present. 

```{python}
# Coefficients
beta0 = logistic_regression.intercept_[0]
beta_age, beta_chol = logistic_regression.coef_[0]

# 1) For a 55-year-old, chol level where model is right at 50% (decision boundary)
chol_50 = -(beta0 + beta_age * 55) / beta_chol
chol_50
```

```{python}
logit_90 = np.log(0.9/0.1) # log (p/(1-p)) with p=0.9
chol_90 = (logit_90 -beta0 - beta_age * 55)/beta_chol
chol_90
```

## Linear Discriminant Analysis
```{python}
lda = LinearDiscriminantAnalysis()
lda.fit(X, y)
```

```{python}
print(lda.coef_, lda.intercept_)

coef_age, coef_chol = lda.coef_[0]
intercept = lda.intercept_[0]
print(f"{coef_age:.6f} age + {coef_chol:.6f} chol + {intercept:.6f} = 0")

chol_55 = -(coef_age * 55 + intercept) / coef_chol
print(chol_55)
```

Would need to have cholestorol level of 368.235357529938. 

## Support Vector Classifier
```{python}
svc = SVC(kernel='linear')
svc.fit(X, y)
```

```{python}
print(svc.coef_, svc.intercept_)

coef_age, coef_chol = svc.coef_[0]
intercept = svc.intercept_[0]
print(f"{coef_age:.6f} age + {coef_chol:.6f} chol + {intercept:.6f} = 0")

chol_55 = -(coef_age * 55 + intercept) / coef_chol
print(chol_55)
```

Would need to have cholestorol level of 312.7005277830234.
